clips.title: The story
paras: High Executor Derrington commands the Forsaken vanguard stationed at the Bulwark on the eastern border of Tirisfal Glades. A no-nonsense military officer, he oversees the Horde's front-line defense against the Scourge and Scarlet Crusade threats emanating from the Western Plaguelands. From this fortified barricade, he directs seasoned champions toward contested ruins like Andorhal and Scholomance.

Standing directly before the fortified barricades of the Bulwark, High Executor Derrington serves as the gatekeeper between the haunted safety of Tirisfal Glades and the rotting horrors of the Western Plaguelands. Derrington holds little patience for political maneuvering in the Undercity, viewing the front lines as a crucible of sheer survival. For Horde soldiers and sellswords seeking to test their mettle, Derrington provides direct military orders, sending scouts and strike teams deep into plagueridden territory to blunt enemy incursions before they breach Tirisfal.

Derrington's defensive position is beleaguered on multiple axes. To the east lies the Scourge, entrenched in the shattered town of Andorhal and spilling through the countryside via corrupting cauldrons. Simultaneously, the zealous fanatics of the Scarlet Crusade contest northern fortifications and skirmish relentlessly with Forsaken patrols. Derrington coordinates surgical counterattacks, sabotage against the Scarlet lines, and the systematic disruption of Scourge cauldron fields to safeguard the eastern border.
